Scent notes

  • Top Notes: Petitgrain

Details

  • Unisex: for men and women
  • Brand: Thomas Kosmala
  • 100% authentic, dispatched from the UK

Details

Trussardi Pure Jasmine Eau de Parfum 7ml Miniature is an elegant and feminine fragrance with bright citrus, creamy floral and warm woody accords. Bergamot, pistachio and neroli open the scent, while jasmine and champaca create a rich floral heart. Vanilla, sandalwood and patchouli give the fragrance a smooth, sensual finish. The 7ml miniature size is ideal for travel, gifting or collecting.

  • Top Notes: Bergamot, Pistachio, Neroli
  • Heart Notes: Jasmine, Champaca, Mugane
  • Base Notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Patchouli

Barcode: 8058045433132

Elie Saab Le Parfum Lumière Eau de Parfum is a radiant and elegant women’s fragrance with luminous citrus, white florals and warm woody accords. Orange blossom and jasmine blend with tuberose, ylang-ylang and patchouli for a sophisticated, feminine scent. This gift set includes a 90ml Eau de Parfum, a 10ml travel spray and a 75ml body lotion.

  • Top Notes: Mandarin Orange, Orange Blossom, Ylang-Ylang
  • Heart Notes: Jasmine, Tuberose
  • Base Notes: Patchouli, Amber, Musk
  • 1 x 90ml Elie Saab Le Parfum Lumière Eau de Parfum
  • 1 x 10ml Eau de Parfum Travel Spray
  • 1 x 75ml Body Lotion

Barcode: 7640233341605

Elie Saab Le Parfum Gift Set combines the iconic women’s Eau de Parfum with matching body lotion and shower gel for a complete fragrance ritual. Elegant orange blossom and jasmine blend with honey, rose, cedarwood and patchouli to create a luminous, feminine and sophisticated scent.

  • Top Note: Orange Blossom
  • Heart Notes: Jasmine, Grandiflorum Jasmine
  • Base Notes: Cedarwood, Patchouli, Honey, Rose
  • 1 x 90ml Elie Saab Le Parfum Eau de Parfum
  • 1 x 75ml Body Lotion
  • 1 x 75ml Shower Gel

Barcode: 7640233340967

Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Le Parfum Eau de Parfum 150ml is a bold and modern men’s fragrance with aromatic, leathery and woody accords. Grapefruit and hemp open into black pepper and geranium, while leather and vetiver create a deep, masculine and long-lasting finish.

  • Top Notes: Grapefruit, Hemp
  • Heart Notes: Black Pepper, Geranium
  • Base Notes: Leather, Vetiver

Barcode: 8411061002865

Refined yet distinctive, it offers a smooth, sophisticated scent in a compact size ideal for travel or fragrance discovery.

  • Top Notes: Lavender, Fresh Aromatic Notes
  • Heart Notes: Floral Accord, Coconut
  • Base Notes: Amber, Woods, Musk

Barcode: 3616305187420

  • Top Notes: Mandarin, Pink Pepper
  • Heart Notes: Lavender, Suede Accord
  • Base Notes: Vetiver, Amber, Woods

Barcode: 3616304175848

Coach Green Shower Gel 100ml is a refreshing men’s body wash inspired by the crisp, aromatic character of Coach Green. It gently cleanses the skin while leaving behind a fresh scent with citrus, green and woody accords, making it a practical addition to a daily grooming routine.

  • Top Notes: Kiwi, Bergamot
  • Heart Notes: Rosemary, Geranium
  • Base Notes: Cedarwood, Moss

Barcode: 3386460141314

Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau de Toilette 75ml is a fresh, energetic and masculine fragrance with fruity, aromatic and woody accords. Green apple and tea create a crisp opening, while tonka bean, cedarwood and musk give the scent a smooth, modern finish.

  • Top Notes: Green Apple, Tea, Bitter Orange
  • Heart Notes: Moss, Tonka Bean
  • Base Notes: Cedarwood, Musk

Barcode: 3351500015238

Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum 90ml is a deep, sensual and sophisticated women’s fragrance with rich floral, fruity and amber accords. Jasmine and peach nectar blend with a luxurious rose heart, while amber and patchouli create a warm, elegant and long-lasting finish.

  • Top Note: Jasmine
  • Heart Notes: Peach Nectar, Candied Rose
  • Base Notes: Amber, Patchouli

Barcode: 3614229829006

Burberry My Burberry Eau de Parfum 90ml is an elegant women’s floral fragrance inspired by a London garden after the rain. Fresh bergamot and sweet pea blend with geranium, quince and freesia, while patchouli and rose create a refined, feminine and sophisticated finish.

  • Top Notes: Sweet Pea, Bergamot
  • Heart Notes: Geranium Leaf, Golden Quince, Freesia
  • Base Notes: Patchouli, Damask Rose, Centifolia Rose

Barcode: 3614226905963

  • Top Notes: Spicy Citrus, Aromatic Notes
  • Heart Notes: Leather, Dark Woods
  • Base Notes: Amber, Vanilla, Musk

Barcode: 7640365140510

Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Shower Gel 200ml is a luxurious perfumed body wash inspired by the iconic Classique fragrance. Its silky gel texture creates a soft lather while leaving the skin delicately scented with the feminine floral and powdery character of Classique. 

  • Key Notes: Orange Blossom, Ginger, Powdery Accord, Vanilla

Barcode: 8435415011402

  • Heart Notes: Lilac, Rose, Violet, Geranium
  • Base Notes: Patchouli, Amber Notes

Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum 150ml is a warm, elegant and sophisticated men’s fragrance with spicy, aromatic and woody accords. Grapefruit, cardamom and ginger blend with tobacco, amber and cedarwood to create a smooth, masculine and long-lasting scent. Presented in the new packaging.

  • Top Notes: Grapefruit, Coriander, Basil
  • Heart Notes: Cardamom, Ginger, Orange Blossom
  • Base Notes: Tobacco, Amber, Cedarwood
